purpose: Regression reproducers: each test run in its own process against the reviewed baseline, then against the fixed HEAD (all 128 pass).

baselines.4548dc09948702eb6a039287af5807bac95d92a6: reviewed baseline; used for the whisper (ts-session) and grouped-move (core) tests, because 57c1902 already contains those two fixes
baselines.57c1902: baseline + whisper + grouped-move fixes + an injectable voice target/timing seam in DiscordBot, which the real-library harness needs to build a bot at all

shimsOnBaselineWorktree: DiscordBot.voiceConnection: read-only accessor over the existing private connection (no behaviour change)
BridgeRuntime.idle(): awaits the existing queue twice (no behaviour change)
core/opus-packet.ts: identity splitter, modelling the baseline passing every packet through as one 20 ms frame

classification.RED-BEHAVIOURAL: fails on the defect itself (wrong output, missing behaviour, time-out waiting for the fixed behaviour)
classification.RED-NEW-API: fails because the fix introduces the API the test calls; evidence of the change, not proof of the defect
classification.GREEN-ON-BASELINE (guard): already passes on the baseline; protects behaviour the fixes must not break
